details: A sixth consecutive day of US airstrikes against Iran, coupled with the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz, has fueled a risk-off sentiment in financial markets. This geopolitical escalation has dampened investor appetite for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin is currently holding around $64,300, while Ethereum has shown some relative outperformance at approximately $1,860. The broader crypto market experienced a pullback despite earlier hopes stemming from a softer inflation report.
title: US-Iran Tensions & Strait of Hormuz Dampen Crypto Market
